description: Claim-relations graph for VenturaAtlas. Records the relationship between evidence sources, claims, and ideas. Supports the OMEGA XIX truth-lattice architecture.
evidenceAuthorityNote: Source authority is claim-specific, not universal. A government regulation is excellent evidence for LEGAL_SCOPE claims and poor evidence for WILLINGNESS_TO_PAY claims. Score evidence relationships per claim type.
forbiddenPractices: A single sourceQuality score applied to all claim types
LLM consensus used to resolve factual conflicts
UNKNOWN scores silently averaged with known scores

schema.sourceIds: array of source IDs that bear on this claim
schema.freshnessPolicyDays: integer — days before this claim type goes STALE
schema.assumptions: array of assumption strings that must hold for this claim to be valid
